title: Second-Order Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridges with Partial State Information
summary: Motivated by scenarios in control systems where decision making is informed by only partial information about the states, we introduce a novel formulation of the Schrödinger bridge problem for inertial interacting-agent systems. Within our setting, the agent ensemble is steered to match partial specifications of the collective configuration. Our analysis pertains to a mean-field framework in which the collective dynamics are described by a nonlinear Vlasov--Fokker--Planck integro-PDE with nonlocal interactions.
